tasks.title: Add resolve_signals(ev, finding) entry point to ngv2/confidence_signals.py via R-anchored symbol patch
acceptance_criteria: A new module-level function resolve_signals(ev, finding=None) is added to ngv2/confidence_signals.py.
The patch is emitted as a __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ symbol patch with name='build_confidence_signals', R-anchored on the existing top-level build_confidence_signals.
Inside the patch code block, resolve_signals appears FIRST (the extra node) and build_confidence_signals is reproduced VERBATIM LAST (the anchor / final def).
build_confidence_signals is reproduced byte-for-byte; its behavior is unchanged.
A verbatim ev['signals'] list is returned unchanged.
When ev['signals'] is absent, produce_semantic_signals from ngv2.semantic_signals is run over ev['source'] and the result is folded together with ev['live_report'] via build_confidence_signals.
An explicit finding argument overrides ev['finding'].
Any import/derivation failure degrades to an empty/None list and never raises; bad input ({} or None) returns a list or None.
No existing imports or other functions in the module are modified; ngv2/session_gate.py, ngv2/semantic_signals.py, ngv2/grounding_confidence_gate.py and all other modules are untouched.
Verification command passes: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_resolve_signals_wired.py tests/test_confidence_signals_wired.py -q

spec.objective: Add a single module-level entry point resolve_signals(ev, finding=None) to the existing module ngv2/confidence_signals.py that turns an evidence dict into the compute_confidence signal list, so the live triage->verify FSM gate wiring becomes a one-line change. Emit it as an additive, R-anchored symbol patch on build_confidence_signals so the new function is inserted immediately before the verbatim-reproduced anchor.
functional_requirements: Add module-level resolve_signals(ev, finding=None) to ngv2/confidence_signals.py, emitted as a __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ symbol patch (name='build_confidence_signals') R-anchored on the existing top-level build_confidence_signals.
Honor a verbatim ev['signals'] list when present: return it unchanged without running any verifier.
When ev['signals'] is absent and ev['source'] is truthy, import and run ngv2.semantic_signals.produce_semantic_signals(finding_d, source, language) to obtain structural semantic signals.
Fold the semantic signals together with any ev['live_report'] detonation verdict into the final signal list via the existing build_confidence_signals in the same module.
Resolve the finding to use as finding_d: an explicit finding argument (when a dict) overrides ev['finding']; otherwise use ev['finding'] when a dict, else {}.
Be tolerant: any import/derivation/build failure degrades to an empty/None list and never raises; bad input ({} or None for ev) returns a list or None.

Reproduce build_confidence_signals byte-for-byte as the R-anchor with resolve_signals FIRST and build_confidence_signals as the final def in the patch code block; do not change its behavior, the module's existing imports, or any other function/module.
spec.interfaces: resolve_signals(ev, finding=None) -> list | None . Reads ev.get('signals'), ev.get('source'), ev.get('language'), ev.get('live_report'), ev.get('finding'). Calls ngv2.semantic_signals.produce_semantic_signals(finding, source_code, language) and the in-module build_confidence_signals(finding, *, semantic_signals=None, live_report=None) -> list. Anchor build_confidence_signals(finding: dict, *, semantic_signals: list | None=None, live_report: dict | object | None=None) -> list[dict] is reproduced verbatim.
edge_cases: ev is None or {} (no 'signals', no 'source') -> returns a list or None, never raises.
ev['signals'] present (even empty list) -> returned unchanged verbatim, verifier not invoked.
ev is not a dict -> get falls back to a lambda returning defaults; no AttributeError.
produce_semantic_signals import fails or raises -> semantic_signals degrades to [].
build_confidence_signals raises -> degrade to semantic_signals or None.
ev['live_report'] confirmed -> live_poc proof folded in; unconfirmed -> no proof added.
Explicit finding arg is non-dict -> fall back to ev['finding'] (if dict) else {}.
non_goals: No integration wiring of the FSM gate itself.
Do not modify build_confidence_signals behavior (byte-for-byte anchor).
Do not modify ngv2/session_gate.py, ngv2/semantic_signals.py, ngv2/grounding_confidence_gate.py, or any other module.
No network, subprocess, clock, LLM, or randomness.
Do not change the module's existing imports or other functions; do not emit a whole-file replacement.
spec.implementation_notes:
Emit exactly the two functions from the brief's Deliverables block in this order: resolve_signals FIRST (the extra node) then build_confidence_signals reproduced VERBATIM LAST (the anchor / final def). The harness inserts extras immediately before the R-anchor, so build_confidence_signals must be the final def in the code block. files_touched lists only ngv2/confidence_signals.py. Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

## tests/test_resolve_signals_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ``ngv2.confidence_signals.resolve_signals`` (Phase 3 wiring helper).

``resolve_signals(ev, finding=None)`` is the single entry point the live
``_gate_triage_to_verify`` calls to turn an evidence dict into the
``compute_confidence`` signal list -- running the structural verifier over
``ev['source']`` and folding in any ``ev['live_report']``. Pulling the
derivation into this (worker-friendly) module keeps the gate change a one-liner.

Hermetic: the stdlib AST verifier runs over inline source; no I/O.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from ngv2.confidence_signals import resolve_signals
from ngv2.grounding_confidence_gate import compute_confidence

CMDI_SOURCE = (
    "import os\n"
    "def lookup_host(host):\n"
    "    return os.system('getent hosts ' + host)\n"
)
CMDI_FINDING = {'id': 'command_injection', 'category': 'command_injection',
                'cwe': 'CWE-78', 'evidence': ['svc.py:3']}
EVAL_FINDING = {'id': 'eval_usage', 'category': 'eval_usage', 'cwe': 'CWE-95'}


def test_verbatim_signals_are_honored():
    sig = [{'tool': 'x', 'kind': 'live_poc', 'result': 'proof'}]
    assert resolve_signals({'finding': EVAL_FINDING, 'signals': sig}) == sig


def test_real_source_yields_taint_flow_proof_to_confirmed():
    signals = resolve_signals({'finding': CMDI_FINDING, 'source': CMDI_SOURCE,
                               'language': 'python'})
    assert any(s.get('result') == 'proof' for s in signals)
    assert compute_confidence(CMDI_FINDING, signals) == 'CONFIRMED'


def test_confirmed_live_report_yields_live_poc_proof():
    signals = resolve_signals({'finding': EVAL_FINDING,
                               'live_report': {'verdict': 'confirmed'}})
    assert compute_confidence(EVAL_FINDING, signals) == 'CONFIRMED'


def test_unconfirmed_report_no_proof():
    signals = resolve_signals({'finding': EVAL_FINDING,
                               'live_report': {'verdict': 'unconfirmed'}})
    assert compute_confidence(EVAL_FINDING, signals) != 'CONFIRMED'


def test_finding_arg_overrides_evidence_finding():
    signals = resolve_signals({'source': CMDI_SOURCE, 'language': 'python'},
                              CMDI_FINDING)
    assert any(s.get('result') == 'proof' for s in signals)


def test_total_over_bad_input():
    assert resolve_signals({}) in ([], None) or isinstance(resolve_signals({}), list)
    assert resolve_signals(None) in ([], None) or isinstance(resolve_signals(None), list)

```

## tests/test_confidence_signals_wired.py
```python
"""RED wiring oracle for ``ngv2.confidence_signals`` (Phase 3.2).

Proves the confidence-signal PRODUCER assembles the live ``compute_confidence``
input from the real scan (a regex finding -> a ``pattern`` match), the P3.1
structural semantic signals, and a REAL live-detonation report (a ``confirmed``
verdict -> a ``live_poc`` structural proof) -- replacing the hand-faked
``signals = [...]`` literal. A non-confirmed detonation must NOT contribute a
proof, so marker-spoofing cannot manufacture confidence.

Hermetic: pure assembly over dicts; no I/O.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import inspect
import pytest
from ngv2.confidence_signals import build_confidence_signals
from ngv2.grounding_confidence_gate import compute_confidence

mutation_target = 'ngv2.confidence_signals'

FINDING = {'id': 'eval_usage', 'category': 'eval_usage', 'cwe': 'CWE-95'}


def test_signature_is_frozen():
    sig = inspect.signature(build_confidence_signals)
    assert list(sig.parameters)[0] == 'finding'
    assert 'semantic_signals' in sig.parameters
    assert 'live_report' in sig.parameters


def test_scan_finding_contributes_a_pattern_match():
    signals = build_confidence_signals(FINDING)
    assert any(s.get('kind') == 'pattern' and s.get('result') == 'match'
               for s in signals)
    # scan-only -> exactly one match -> MEDIUM
    assert compute_confidence(FINDING, signals) == 'MEDIUM'


def test_confirmed_detonation_contributes_live_poc_proof():
    signals = build_confidence_signals(
        FINDING, live_report={'verdict': 'confirmed'})
    proofs = [s for s in signals
              if s.get('kind') == 'live_poc' and s.get('result') == 'proof']
    assert proofs, f'confirmed detonation produced no live_poc proof: {signals}'
    assert compute_confidence(FINDING, signals) == 'CONFIRMED'


def test_unconfirmed_detonation_contributes_no_proof():
    """A non-confirmed (e.g. marker-only) detonation must not yield a proof."""
    for verdict in ('unconfirmed', 'inconclusive', 'refuted', None):
        signals = build_confidence_signals(
            FINDING, live_report={'verdict': verdict})
        assert not any(s.get('result') == 'proof' for s in signals), verdict
        assert compute_confidence(FINDING, signals) != 'CONFIRMED'


def test_semantic_signals_are_merged_through():
    sem = [{'tool': 'ast_verifier', 'kind': 'taint_flow', 'result': 'proof'}]
    signals = build_confidence_signals(FINDING, semantic_signals=sem)
    assert any(s.get('kind') == 'taint_flow' and s.get('result') == 'proof'
               for s in signals)
    assert compute_confidence(FINDING, signals) == 'CONFIRMED'


def test_full_assembly_scan_plus_semantic_plus_live():
    sem = [{'tool': 'ast_verifier', 'kind': 'taint_flow', 'result': 'proof'}]
    signals = build_confidence_signals(
        FINDING, semantic_signals=sem, live_report={'verdict': 'confirmed'})
    kinds = {s.get('kind') for s in signals}
    assert {'pattern', 'taint_flow', 'live_poc'} <= kinds
    assert compute_confidence(FINDING, signals) == 'CONFIRMED'


def test_total_over_empty_inputs():
    assert isinstance(build_confidence_signals({}), list)
    assert isinstance(build_confidence_signals(None), list)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

```
